title: 🔆🔅New Delhi, India - September 5th - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary made some remarks at the BRICS Chief Justices’ Forum, hosted by the Supreme Court of India from 4–6 September 2026.
text:
🔆🔅New Delhi, India - September 5th - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary made some remarks at the BRICS Chief Justices’ Forum, hosted by the Supreme Court of India from 4–6 September 2026."

""
"SOT1, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:44): "We call upon the esteemed members of BRICS: first, to condemn the violation of the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Iran in accordance with international law, particularly the United Nations Charter, and to take the necessary measures to prevent the illegal actions of the aggressors; and second, to prosecute the perpetrators of war crimes and crimes against humanity during the two wars of aggression against the Islamic Republic, by exercising universal jurisdiction.""

"SOT2, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:45 - 01:11): "Our judicial systems and legal institutions must not remain indifferent to the violations of fundamental human rights, the massacre of civilians, the forced displacement of populations, the damage caused to infrastructure, and the impunity enjoyed by the perpetrators of international crimes.
